acceptance_criterion.claim: selected candidate is worth experimental validation
acceptance_criterion.criterion: compare its measured 120 C hold behavior with the original references
acceptance_criterion.failure_condition: candidate shows clearly worse hold drift than the original reference formulations

alternatives_considered.relative_reason: Balanced PDP70/PPG2000 composition corresponding proportionally to the E2 reference, but no E2 thermal-hold measurement is supplied.
Balanced PDP70/PPG2000 composition corresponding proportionally to the E3 reference, but no E3 thermal-hold measurement is supplied.

selection_rationale: S1C01 is the proportional scaled composition matching E1, the only original formulation with a relatively small 120 C hold increase over 15-60 min (708.7 to 776.1), whereas E5 shows a much larger increase (2210.0 to 3349.0). This supports S1C01 as the most reasonable validation candidate, without claiming candidate performance in advance.

evidence_coverage.note: Only E1 and E5 have thermal-hold data; candidate-specific hold coverage is absent.

extrapolation.note: Selection extrapolates from proportional composition matching and reference hold behavior.

measurement.note: No direct 120 C thermal-hold measurement is supplied for any candidate.

process_history.note: The supplied payload does not provide complete candidate process histories.

repeatability.note: Original measurements include differing run labels and limited retesting, so candidate repeatability is unestablished.
